name: P40 lite 5G

Launch.Successor: Huawei Nova 8 SE, Huawei Nova 8 SE Youth

Body.Other: Side-mounted fingerprint scanner (integrated into power button), proximity sensor, ambient light sensor, accelerometer, gyroscope, compass

Platform.Operating system: Initial: Android 10 with EMUI 10.1, Current:, P40 lite 5G: Android 11 with EMUI 12, Nova 7 SE & 7 SE 5G Youth: HarmonyOS 2.0, Without Google Play Services
Platform.CPU: P40 lite 5G: Kirin 820 5G (7 nm), 8 cores (1×2.36 GHz Cortex-A76 & 3×2.22 GHz Cortex-A76 & 4×1.84 GHz Cortex-A55), Nova 7 SE 5G Youth: MediaTek Dimensity 800U 5G (7 nm), 8 cores (2×2.4 GHz Cortex-A76 & 6×2.0 GHz Cortex-A55)
Platform.GPU: P40 lite 5G: Mali-G57 (6 cores), Nova 7 SE 5G Youth: Mali-G57 MC3

Memory.RAM: P40 lite 5G: 6 GB, Nova 7 SE: 6/8 GB, Nova 7 SE 5G Youth: 8 GB, LPDDR4X
Memory.Storage: P40 lite 5G & Nova 7 SE 5G Youth: 128 GB, Nova 7 SE: 128/256 GB, UFS 2.1
Memory.Card slot: P40 lite 5G: NM (Nano Memory) up to 256 GB, Nova 7 SE 5G Youth: None

Display.Display: LTPS IPS LCD, 6.5", 2400 × 1080 pixels (FullHD+), 20:9 ratio, 405 ppi, HDR10

Cameras.Rear camera: 64 MP Sony IMX686, 26 mm (wide), PDAF + 8 MP, 17 mm (ultrawide) + 2 MP, (macro) + 2 MP, (depth sensor), LED flash, HDR, panorama, Video: 4K@30fps, 1080p@30fps, 720p@960fps

Connectivity.Connectivity: USB-C 2.0, Bluetooth 5.1 (A2DP, LE), NFC (P40 lite 5G), Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac (dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, hotspot), GPS, A-GPS, GLONASS, BDS, GALILEO
